card.name: Linking words before adverse-effect terms
card.fires_on: The small word "of" (sometimes "a" or "the") right after "frequency and/or severity" or "increase the risk" in drug-interaction text. It comes just before a list of side effects or adverse reactions.

modes.label: Severity/risk of
modes.description: The word "of" after "frequency and/or severity" or "risk" in an interaction warning, before the effects.
modes.example: may increase the frequency and/or severity<< of>> dry mouth, constipation, blurred vision

modes.label: Other linking words
modes.description: "a" or "the" in a sentence about a side effect or reduced efficacy.
modes.example: Flushing of the skin occurs as<< a>> side effect when nicotinic acid therapy

card.plain: It marks the small word just before the side effects that an interacting drug may make more frequent or more severe.
